$comment: Three tracker projects, one per team. PLAT and CHK run two-week sprints; INS
runs Kanban and therefore has no sprints, no story points and no sprint goal —
the generator refuses to give it any, and a test asserts the absence.
`issueCount` and `implementedCount` set the volume. `implementedCount` is the
number of issues that get a branch, commits and a pull request; the rest are
tracker-only work, which is what real backlogs look like.
